source.title: Brandenburg Concerto No. 5 in D major, BWV 1050 — III. Allegro
source.encoder: Joshua Koo; LilyPond 2.18 update and A–B–A corrections by Joram Berger

method: Public-domain LilyPond/MIDI → voice-aware performed event table; tuning estimated with librosa; Sync Toolbox 1.4.2 memory-restricted multiscale DTW at 50 frames/s, chroma + DLNCO. First/last attacks anchored by score-pitch energy rises in documented inspection windows; section anchors refined by DTW and checked against existing passage labels. Note-offs are warped notation, not measured key releases; final written holds extend to an estimated decay threshold. No aural review. See tools/align/REPORT.md.
repeats: Complete movement III, 310 engraved 2/4 bars in written order. The source’s repeat unfold constructs already write out the A–B–A return, with staggered staff-rest prefixes and alternatives; no additional repeat traversal is applied. The opening rests stay within bar 1, not an invented pickup.
